protocol.noise_information: Detector receives calibrated speed/yaw sensor noise SD; here supplied from simulator settings, not estimated online.
protocol.noise_model: Independent Gaussian state-observation samples; exact short-minus-current-window noise variance retains MA(1) force-noise correlation.
protocol.detection: Compare per-wheel LS over last 40 transitions with current window; any side above max(0.10, 4*noise_SD) for five updates triggers shrinkage.
protocol.regrowth: Hold W=40 for 40 updates after alarm, then add one sample each update to W=160; growing window starts no earlier than last alarm.
protocol.startup: Adaptive estimator holds nominal eta until 160 transitions collected; no monitoring before 3.2 s. Fixed short windows start earlier.
protocol.truth_isolation: Adaptive API takes observations, commands, supplied noise SD only; it has no true efficiency or fault time.
protocol.primary_metrics: Unchanged steady 10-20 s RMSE and in-band fraction; first left error<=0.05 for 0.5 s confirms recovery, including hold time.
protocol.failure_handling: Failures count as infinite for overall median; stored as null. Missing plotted medians remain gaps.
protocol.aggregation: Four preset varying-input phases share paired noise seeds; descriptive comparisons, not independent-trial significance claims. Noiseless seeds repeat identical trajectories.
protocol.healthy_control: No efficiency change, same five input profiles, noise 0.01; count false alarms across full monitored interval 3.2-20 s.
protocol.scope: Rule-based illustrative prototype; known remaining dynamics, supplied correct noise specification, one sustained change, no slip/process noise or closed-loop control. Frequent changes and noise miscalibration untested.
